scripts.clean:dist: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true,maxRetries:10,retryDelay:200});if(fs.existsSync('dist')){console.error('clean:dist failed: dist/ still exists - a running process (e.g. the API server) is holding files. Stop it and rebuild, or the old bundles stay behind and get served.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: npm run clean:dist && tsc -b && vite build
